name: Rowan Ellison
title: Broker and owner
specialty: The firm, and the older houses in the Reach and the Square
summary: The second generation at the firm. Knows the plat book as well as the streets.
body:
Rowan took over Gablefen Realty from her father, Ed Ellison, in 2011, and has been with the office since 1998.

She still takes a handful of listings herself, usually the older houses and anything facing the square.

name: Evan Rowell
title: Listing agent
specialty: West Common foursquares and Ridge Lane
summary: Handles a large share of the Common and ridge listings, and the firm's weekly open houses.
body:
Evan came to the office after a first career in the county assessor's office, which is why his listing sheets are unusually careful about square footage and taxes.

This is also the signed-in demo account for the agent desk.

name: Priya Sandoval
title: Buyer's agent
summary: Works mostly with buyers, especially people new to town and anyone looking on Ferry Green.
body:
Priya grew up two towns over and moved to Gablefen for the job. She keeps a standing Saturday morning on the Green.

Buyer clients who sign in see the showing notes she leaves after a tour.

name: Ned Halberg
title: Agent
specialty: Mill Reach cottages and the mill lofts
summary: The Reach specialist: cottages, lofts, and anything that backs onto the race.
body:
Ned has lived in Mill Reach for twenty years and has sold more cottages than anyone else in the office.

He also keeps the informal list of which mill lofts have a river window and which only face the yard.

name: Lila Quinton
title: Agent
specialty: New listings and the Saturday market table
summary: The newest agent. Staffs the window, the market table, and a growing list of her own.
body:
Lila joined after a few years at the county historical society. She writes most of the public market notes on this site.

On market Saturdays she is at the lawn table from eight until noon.
